flora: Scale-covered branchlet (twigs covered entirely in tiny, overlapping, appressed scales)
Small oval pollen cone (slender, yellow-tinted cone clustering at a branch tip)
Branching node (chunky joint where the braided green shoots diverge)
Fossilized imprint (clear relief mapping of a scaly stem in light grey limestone)
environment_details.style_notes: STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3; foliage must look like braided cords; avoid thin, sharp pine needles; focus on the repetitive pattern of the tiny scales; toy-like density.

visual_logic.composition: Tiled layout: Top-Left: a macro view of the braided green scale patterns on the branchlet; Top-Right: a cluster of tiny, pale yellow pollen cones; Bottom-Left: a split branch junction showing thick woody joints; Bottom-Right: a crisp fossil impression in a pale limestone fragment.
visual_logic.ground: A stark backdrop of fine-grained white limestone rock, preventing any environment-scale confusion.
visual_logic.lighting: Soft, multi-directional light that casts light shadows into the crevices of the scales and fossil grooves.
